nodes.summary: Let $F_k$ denote the $k$-th Fibonacci number, with $F_0 = 0$ and $F_1 = 1$. For every natural number $n \ge 1$, the following identities hold in the integers: $\sum_{i=1}^{n} F_{2i-1} = F_{2n}$; $\sum_{i=1}^{n} F_{2i} = F_{2n+1} - 1$; $\sum_{i=1}^{n} i F_i = n F_{n+2} - F_{n+3} + 2$; $\sum_{i=1}^{n} F_i F_{3i} = F_n F_{n+1} F_{2n+1}$; and $\sum_{i=1}^{n} \binom{n}{i} F_i = F_{2n}$.
nodes.title: Classical Fibonacci sum identities

nodes.summary: Let $x_1, \dots, x_N$ be $N \ge 1$ positive real numbers, and for real $p$ write $S^{[p]} = \sum_{k=1}^{N} x_k^p$. If $\alpha$ and $\beta$ are real numbers with $0 < \alpha < \beta$, then $S^{[\alpha]} \le N (S^{[\beta]} / N)^{\alpha/\beta}$. If moreover $x_k \ge 1$ for every $k$, then also $N (S^{[\beta]} / N)^{\alpha/\beta} \le S^{[\beta]}$.
nodes.title: Power mean bound for power sums with a smaller exponent

nodes.summary: Let $x_1, \dots, x_N$ be $N \ge 1$ positive real numbers, and for real $p$ write $S^{[p]} = \sum_{k=1}^{N} x_k^p$. If $\alpha$ and $\beta$ are real numbers with $0 < \beta \le \alpha$, then $S^{[\alpha]} \le (S^{[\beta]})^{\alpha/\beta}$.
nodes.title: Power sums under a larger exponent

nodes.summary: Let $0 < x_1 \le \dots \le x_N$ be $N \ge 1$ real numbers, and for real $p$ write $S^{[p]} = \sum_{k=1}^{N} x_k^p$. For all real $r, s > 0$, $S^{[r]} S^{[s]} / \max(x_N^{r/2} S^{[s/2]}, x_N^{s/2} S^{[r/2]}) \le S^{[(r+s)/2]}$.
nodes.title: Lower bound for a power sum at the mean exponent

nodes.summary: Let $n \ge 0$ and let $x_1, \dots, x_n$ be positive real numbers. If $\alpha$ and $\beta$ are real numbers with $0 < \beta < \alpha$, then $(\sum_{k=1}^{n} x_k^\alpha)^{1/\alpha} \le (\sum_{k=1}^{n} x_k^\beta)^{1/\beta}$.
nodes.title: Normalised power sums decrease in the exponent

nodes.summary: Let $F_k$ denote the $k$-th Fibonacci number. For every natural number $n \ge 1$ and every real $\alpha$ with $0 < \alpha < 2$, $\sum_{k=1}^{n} F_k^\alpha \le n (F_n F_{n+1} / n)^{\alpha/2} \le F_n F_{n+1}$.
nodes.title: Upper bounds for Fibonacci power sums with exponent below 2

nodes.summary: Let $F_k$ denote the $k$-th Fibonacci number. For every natural number $n \ge 1$ and every real $\alpha \ge 2$, $\sum_{k=1}^{n} F_k^\alpha \le (F_n F_{n+1})^{\alpha/2}$.
nodes.title: Upper bound for Fibonacci power sums with exponent at least 2

nodes.summary: Let $F_k$ denote the $k$-th Fibonacci number. For every natural number $n \ge 1$ and all real $r, s$ with $r + s \ge 4$, $(F_n F_{n+1})^2 \le (\sum_{k=1}^{n} F_k^r)(\sum_{k=1}^{n} F_k^s)$, where $F_k^r$ and $F_k^s$ are real powers, with equality if and only if $n = 1$, or $n = 2$, or $n \ge 3$ and $r = s = 2$.
nodes.title: Product of two Fibonacci power sums
